messages:
Maya T: Heads-up 11 BridgePath RFI landed. They want a single package: capability matrix, PoC runbook, redacted HSM attestation, EU-only data confirmation, and cost scenarios for 500k calls/day for 90 days. Can we split owners?
Ibrahim S: I can own capability matrix + security Qs.
Clara D: I9m on PoC runbook and ops scheduling. Prefer Sat provisioning to avoid their nightly batch.
Maya T: Thanks. Quick asks: 1) Matrix columns, 2) PoC weekend date, 3) Hosted vs Reserved cost estimate, 4) Attestation redaction & delivery method.
Ibrahim S: Proposed columns: Feature | Supported | Deployment modes | EU residency | KMS/HSM | SLA (p95) | Typical p95 (256 tok) | Scale (QPS) | Docs/attachments | Notes.
Clara D: For PoC outline: Sat provisioning (setup), day0 smoke, week1 perf baseline, week2 traffic replay, week3 security checks, week4 handover. Ops can do 2026-05-23 06:00-10:00 UTC. eng-oncall-bot: please tentatively reserve.
eng-oncall-bot: Tentative hold placed for 2026-05-23 06:00-10:00 UTC for BridgePath PoC provisioning. Confirm when PO is approved.
Ibrahim S: Security Q: they require "FIPS 140-2 HSM attestation". We redacted serials previously. sec:policy says share redacted PDF in package; full attestation via SFTP after NDA. Mark as "attestation available on request (secure channel)" in answers.
Maya T: Good. Clara, can you attach an anonymized KMS flow diagram (no IPs) and include the redacted attestation?
Clara D: Will do. Also adding rollback steps and contact list to the runbook.
billing-bot: Draft pricing uploaded: bridgepath_pricing_draft.csv -> https://drive.redwood/bridgepath_pricing_draft.csv
Ibrahim S: For numbers, finance wants assumptions: avg tokens/call=600, token mix 85/15 text/emb. I'll draft hosted PAYG and reserved 8-GPU pool scenarios.
Maya T: Make sure reserved scenario shows monthly commit, burst rules, and estimated effective $/1M tokens. Include sensitivity for 60-90% utilization.
Ibrahim S: Got it. I'll seed the matrix with gen/embeddings/chat rows and link to the draft CSV.
Clara D: Uploaded: bridgepath_poc_runbook_v1.md -> https://drive.redwood/bridgepath_poc_runbook_v1.md and bridgepath_kms_flow_redacted.png -> https://drive.redwood/bridgepath_kms_flow_redacted.png
Ibrahim S: Uploaded: bridgepath_capability_matrix_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/bridgepath_capability_matrix_v1.csv. Added security answer placeholders for attestation and audit logs.
Maya T: Target: finalize package and send to BridgePath security by 2026-05-15 COB. Ibrahim 	6 can you finish pricing and mark "attestation available on request"? Clara 	6 confirm attachment uploads.
Ibrahim S: I'll finish pricing today and ping finance for final numbers.
Clara D: Attachments done. Legal is on standby for NDA text.
Maya T: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker (FedRAMP-like audit log ask, or PO timing), flag here. Otherwise I'll draft the cover email once pricing is final. :mailbox_with_mail:
